findings.remediation: Bind the account as a query parameter instead of interpolating it into the SQL string, so a caller-supplied account cannot alter the statement.
Replace execSync with execFile passing the name as an argv element, so a shell metacharacter in the name is not interpreted as a command.
Remove the hardcoded API key literal and read the secret from the environment or a secret store at call time.
Stop returning the admin key in the response body; the handler leaks it to every caller of the report endpoint.
